title: Simplified mass cytometry protocol for in-plate staining, barcoding, and cryopreservation of human PBMC samples in clinical trials
protocol: Thaw cryopreserved PBMC samples by placing vials in a 37°C circulating water bath until content is thawed, approximately 45 seconds.
Transfer the totality of thawed cell suspensions into 15 mL conical tubes containing 9 mL of warmed to 37°C complete RPMI.
Repeat steps for remaining batches of frozen vials.
Filter samples using 70 μM pre-wetted strainers to obtain a single cell suspension.
Count cells using AO/PI (1:1 dilution; 20 μL sample in 20 μL AO/PI) with the Cellometer® Auto 2000 or an alternative cell counter.
Gently invert the conical tube containing freshly thawed cells to ensure cells are fully resuspended.
Add 20 μL of the AO/PI-diluted sample to a Cellometer® SD100 Cell Counting Chamber.
Adjust volume of cell suspension to achieve a final concentration of 3 × 10^6 cells per condition in complete RPMI.
Centrifuge samples at 400 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare the 103Rh Viability Stain by diluting it 1:500 in warm, complete RPMI.
Carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant after centrifugation without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend the sample in 1 mL of warm, complete RPMI + 103Rh Viability Stain.
Incubate the samples for 15 minutes at room temperature (17°C–25°C).
Aliquot 50 μL of surface stain antibody cocktail per well into designated v-bottomed wells of a 96-well polystyrene plate.
Fill conical tube up to 10 mL with complete RPMI and spin down the samples at 400 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet after centrifugation.
Resuspend each cell pellet in 50 μL CyFACS.
Fc-block: Add 5 μL undiluted Fc-block to each sample.
Incubate the samples on ice for 10 min.
Distribute the totality of Fc-blocked samples into the appropriate wells containing the antibody cocktail according to the plate map.
Incubate the staining plate for 30 min at room temperature.
Prepare eBioScienceTM FoxP3 Fixation/Permeabilization Buffer as per manufacturer protocol by mixing 1 part fix/perm concentrate (00-5123-43) with 3 parts fix/perm diluent (00-5223-56).
Prepare the eBioScienceTM Perm/Wash solution by diluting 5 mL of 10× Permeabilization Buffer stock into 45 mL of Ultra-Pure H2O.
Centrifuge the plate to pellet cells at 400 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Carefully aspirate and discard supernatant from each staining well using a multi-channel pipette, setting for approximately 20 μL less than the volume in the well.
Tilt the plate at a 45° angle during aspiration to avoid aspirating the pellet.
Add 200 μL CyFACs/well using a multichannel pipette.
Centrifuge the plate at 400 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Carefully aspirate and discard supernatant from each staining well using a multi-channel pipette.
Resuspend samples thoroughly in 200 μL of FoxP3 Fixation/Permeabilization Buffer per well, using a multichannel pipette.
Incubate the plate for 30 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge the plate at 800 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Wash samples once with 200 μL of Perm/Wash per well using a multichannel pipette.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend each sample in 50 μL of Perm/Wash per well using a multichannel pipette.
Add 50 μL of intracellular master mix to each well.
Incubate the plate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Add 100 μL of Perm/Wash solution per well using a multichannel pipette.
Centrifuge the plate at 800 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Wash samples with 200 μL of Perm/Wash solution per well using a multichannel pipette.
Centrifuge the plate at 800 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Prepare fresh 4% PFA solution from 16% stock PFA in Ultra-Pure H2O.
Add 200 μL of freshly prepared 4% PFA per well using a multichannel pipette.
Centrifuge the plate at 800 g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Proceed to barcoding.
Prepare 191/193 DNA Intercalator at a 1:5,000 dilution of 191/193 Cell-IDTM Intercalator-Ir in FoxP3 Fixation/Permeabilization Buffer.
Prepare Barcode Perm Buffer according to the manufacturer’s protocol by diluting 1 part 10× Barcode Perm Buffer in 9 parts PBS.
Remove barcode tubes from −20°C.
Briefly spin down barcodes in mini centrifuge.
Resuspend barcodes in 100 μL Barcode Perm Buffer.
Resuspend freshly fixed cells in 100 μL Barcode Perm Buffer per well using multichannel pipette.
Transfer 100 μL of resuspended barcodes to respective wells containing samples using multichannel pipette.
Incubate the plate for 30 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge plate (800 g, 5 min, RT).
Wash samples once with 200 μL of Barcode Perm Buffer using multichannel pipette.
Resuspend each well with 200 μL of Barcode Perm Buffer using multichannel pipette.
Combine all samples from a single barcode batch into a 15 mL conical tube.
Wash combined samples once with 5 mL Barcode Perm Buffer.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation (800 g, 5 min, RT).
Proceed to DNA staining.
Optional: Include a healthy donor sample in each barcoding batch (i.e., 19 clinical samples, one healthy donor sample).
Optional: If running multiple full barcodes, use the same normal donor throughout batches for data quality assessment.
Mix 5 ml of a 1:5,000 dilution of 191/193 DNA Intercalator in FoxP3 Fixation/Permeabilization Buffer per full barcode (20 samples).
Incubate samples at 4°C for 1 hour.
Pellet cells by plate centrifugation at 800 g for 5 minutes at room temperature after incubation.
Carefully aspirate and discard supernatant.
Wash once with 2 ml of Cell Staining Buffer.
Centrifuge the tube(s) at 800 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet(s) in 500 μL of freezing media (85% FBS, 15% DMSO).
Transfer to −20°C for storage immediately.
Thaw samples with 500 μL of warm Complete RPMI per tube(s) on the acquisition day.
Centrifuge the thawed samples at 800 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Wash once with 2 mL of Cell Acquisition Solution (CAS).
Count the total number of cells using a Cellometer® Auto 2000 Cell Viability Counter.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 800 g for 5 minutes.
Load 20 μL of sample directly into a Cellometer® SD100 Cell Counting Chamber to count total cell concentration (in absence of stain).
Count the cells using the Cellometer® Auto 2000 Cell Viability Counter during spin and record final cell count.
Vortex MaxPar EQ Calibration beads for 1 minute before preparing the solution.
Prepare a 1:5 dilution of MaxPar EQ Calibration beads in CAS (CAS/EQ).
Resuspend the samples at a concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells per mL in EQ beads/CAS solution.
Filter resuspended sample through a 35 μm pre-wetted cell strainer cap into a labeled, polypropylene tube in 2 mL aliquots.
